headline: SAFF holds 4.32 on Female Daily (1,746 reviews) for an eleventh flat day, ahead of HMNS (4.15) and newly tracked Onix (4.17), as Mykonos Soft Hour opens online sales on 11 Nov.
kpis_note: Awareness and NPS need a consumer survey; they are not measured from public web data.

insights.text: Female Daily ratings flat vs yesterday and 3 Nov: SAFF 4.32 (1,746 reviews), Alchemist 4.43, Mykonos 4.26, HMNS 4.15. No SAFF product moved.
Onix now tracked: 4.17 across 215 reviews on 14 rated products, with 2 below 4 (Helena 3.0, Scorpio 3.0); its review base is about one-eighth of SAFF's.
Mykonos Soft Hour (with NCT Haechan) sells online from 11 Nov after a 6–8 Nov launch event at Lotte Mall Jakarta.
Weak projection and oily residue recur on Extrait scents: ILIAD (4.6) reviewers say it needs many sprays and marks clothes.
8 ml travel sizes already exist (Rp75k–109k at one retailer, 33 SAFF items listed), but complaints about big or dark bottles still appear, so the small size is not visible enough.

recommendations.text: Counter Mykonos Soft Hour during 11.11: push top-rated scents (Xocolatl, Irai Leima, Troupe, Solaris) with review highlights, and seed TikTok and Instagram creators so SAFF shows up in 'viral' lists.
Align normal vs promo price messaging (ALENCINE/MECHLINE, Maleali, Morfosia) across website, marketplaces and Zalora so constant markdowns do not make 'normal' prices look inflated.
Make the 8 ml travel size easy to find on marketplace listings and in 11.11 bundles as a low-risk trial, especially for strong-opening scents like Irai Leima and S.O.T.B.
Set clear longevity expectations per scent (hours on skin vs fabric) and add wear tips, starting with S.O.T.B, Troupe, ILIAD and Cascavel, so the 'Extrait' label does not over-promise.
Run a short quarterly survey (awareness, consideration, NPS), post a 'how to spot a fake' guide on SAFF channels, and upload a marketplace export to the Drive folder to measure low-star drivers.
